sloka: अस्मिन् क्षणे महाबाहो रावणं त्वं वधिष्यसि ।एवमुक्त्वा तदा ऽगस्त्यो जगाम च यथागतम् ।। ६.१०७.२७ ।।
transliteration: asmin kṣaṇe mahābāho rāvaṇaṁ tvaṁ vadhiṣyasi ।evamuktvā tadā 'gastyo jagāma ca yathāgatam ।। 6.107.27 ।।

translations.english: Agastya having spoken in that way to the mighty armed Rama to worship the Sun God and assuring him that the very moment he will be able to kill Ravana, left in the same way.
